issues.title: Head-on covers now read as seatback monitors (grey glossy plate + white stitch 'chin bar' + light mark 'logo')
issues.evidence: q15 middle covers L88-90 B/R 1.30 sat 0.24 (w19 L65 B/R 1.52) vs y_47300 L37-46 B/R 1.83-2.00; band row p90 L137 from the #8a90a8 stitch; mark #6a7090 shows as a light rectangle lower right (cov15.png). In y_47300 the head-on covers are uniform deep navy with no visible stitch or mark. Oblique e4 unchanged at L40 vs 80-124. r 0.38 mirrors the ceiling head-on; it does not deliver the grazing sheen.
issues.fix: SEATMAT.yCover: r 0.38 -> 0.55, c #262b44 -> #222842 (B/R ~1.9); target q15 middle covers L40-50 B/R >= 1.8, outer L35-55. 09a_econ.js line 122 stitch #8a90a8 -> #3e4562 r 0.6 (head-on stitch <= 1.25x the cover); line 121 hem #30364f r 0.3 -> #2a3049 r 0.6 (hem/cover head-on <= 1.15); line 123 mark #6a7090 -> #3a4058, 2/3 the size. The oblique silver-slate (e4 target L75-110) then needs the cover-only sheen lobe from the w19 lighting hand-off (47e0e43), not a lower roughness.

issues.title: Tick weave too harsh: near-white grains, not pale-blue dashes
issues.fix: make_swatches.py tex_y_tick: drop the 0.5-2.5 cm band boost on tick (or halve it), raise the floor 0.05 -> ~0.12 so the gaps are not near-black, and cut stroke peak ~20 % with fleck B/R ~1.55. Targets: q15 x0.63 p90/p10 3.4-3.7, coverage 0.17-0.20, p10/p50 0.42-0.46; e4 x0.81 p90/p10 ~4.1, fl/gr ~2.9; keep colCV >= 0.15 at q15.

issues.title: Petal fleck right at row distance but coarse 'snow' close up, too much coverage, too blue
issues.evidence: q16 near crown blob 0.35 cm^2 (w19 0.26) vs y_47301 0.19, p90 blob 19 px vs 4, 20 vs 40 blobs per 1000 px, coverage 0.30 vs 0.22; q15 coverage 0.28 vs 0.20, fleck B/R 1.79-1.83 vs 1.61-1.64; q15 fl/gr 2.65-2.70 vs 2.65 (keep).

Re-check that q15 fl/gr stays >= 2.4.
